claims: Jamie Dixon is the head coach of the TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team.
Jamie Dixon has held the position of head coach of the TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team since March 22, 2016.
Jamie Dixon is a 1987 TCU alumnus.
Jamie Dixon has led the TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team to multiple NCAA tournament appearances.
Jamie Dixon is a former National Coach of the Year in 2009.
Jamie Dixon is in his 10th season (2025-26) with the Horned Frogs.
Jamie Dixon led TCU to the most wins in a nine-year period in program history.
Jamie Dixon was the head coach at the University of Pittsburgh from 2003 to 2016.
Jamie Dixon is a two-time USA Basketball gold medalist coach in 2009 and 2021.
Mark Campbell is the head women's basketball coach at TCU.
Mark Campbell was hired as head women's basketball coach at TCU in March 2023
